title: 窗边第一条线
description: 油画小品中的窗边入门墙，低位大把手路线和完整落地区域。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: An original small oil-painting composition shows a fictional adult exploring an easy low bouldering line beside a large gym window. Broad blue jugs curve gently across a cream vertical panel, with large footholds arranged to support an upright relaxed stance. The climber wears an opaque green top and full-length trousers, keeps both feet low, and considers the next comfortable handhold. Include the whole figure, thick uninterrupted crash mats, and warm rectangular window shadows in a medium-wide view. Use visible impasto strokes and rich restrained color rather than photographic skin. The room is peaceful and uncluttered. Exclude words, trademarks, jumping, and anyone beneath the climber.
